stage.name: Mariakirken to Sæteren gård
stage.narrative: The way begins among the ruins of St Mary's Church in Oslo's medieval town and leaves the city on foot. It passes close to Gamle Aker kirke about four and a half kilometres in, then a run of city churches and suburbs, and passes Haslum some twenty kilometres out. The day ends at Sæteren gård, 23.4 km from the start, having climbed 300 m and come down 120 m, with its high point at 210 m.
stage.closing: You leave from the ruins of a church to walk to a cathedral. What are you carrying out of the city with you?
